page_title: INT 1-2 ACM | Inter v AC Milan 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
90+6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
90+5' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+4' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle after Piotr Zielinski (Inter) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+3' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tammy Abraham.
90+1' The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
90+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lautaro Martinez (Inter), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Inter have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

89' 1 - 2 Perfectly taken free kick! Tijjani Reijnders sends the ball in, Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header inside the right post. It's 1:2.
88' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafael Leao trots off the pitch and is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
86' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
86' Federico Dimarco (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
84' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yann Sommer.
83' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
82' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
80' The possession of the ball – 55:45.
79' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Maurizio Mariani signals.
78' Substitution. Alvaro Morata will be replaced by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
78' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) replaces Christian Pulisic.
77' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
75' Great save! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Yann Sommer.
74' Substitution. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) has come on for Nicolo Barella.
74' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.

72' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the inside of the left post, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
72' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
71' A cross from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
70' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Yann Sommer.
68' Simone Inzaghi (Inter) gets a yellow card, off the field.

68' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
66' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to AC Milan as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
66' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for AC Milan. Let’s see what happens!
65' Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to AC Milan!
65' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.

64' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Yann Sommer guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
63' It's time for a substitution. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) comes on in place of Hakan Calhanoglu.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Denzel Dumfries will be replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).
63' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Frattesi (Inter) replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
62' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mike Maignan is well positioned and punches the ball away.

61' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.
60' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Emerson Royal (AC Milan) but poses no threat.
59' The referee blows his whistle as Benjamin Pavard (Inter) was too aggressive in his challenge.
58' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
57' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Benjamin Pavard (Inter).

56' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Mike Maignan and his nice save.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
54' Nicolo Barella (Inter) plays a one-two with Federico Dimarco, but the move breaks down. The ball is behind the touchline and Inter will take a throw-in.
52' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Inter are taking a throw-in.
51' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) commits a foul and Maurizio Mariani immediately signals a free kick.
50' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
48' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
46' Yann Sommer pulls off a brilliant save! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Inter get a corner.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nicolo Barella (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
44' The foul by Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) was seen by Maurizio Mariani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' Inter quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

42' Marcus Thuram (Inter) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Mike Maignan is alert and denies him with a nice save. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' The resulting corner, taken by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), comes to nothing.
38' What was Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

38' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tries his luck with a shot from long range, but his effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

36' AC Milan slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
35' Federico Dimarco (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
33' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes wide of the right post.
31' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) and Lautaro Martinez attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
30' Inter are ruled offside.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Federico Dimarco (Inter) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Lautaro Martinez, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
27' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
26' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
25' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
23' The ball is cleared after Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' The linesman signals that Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
21' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
19' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
15' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
14' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul after Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) hacks down one of his opponents.
13' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will take a throw-in.
12' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

10' 0 - 1 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Yann Sommer is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
9' A cross by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
8' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a long ball in, but Mike Maignan comfortably gathers the ball.
7' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
6' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

6' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, Yann Sommer shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
4' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
3' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will take the corner.
2' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Inter have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
AC Milan will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani was nominated as the referee for this game.
